coord_source_text: in Tihuquine (Chokwe District) located 20 km from the town of Chokwe (24°33'37"S, 33°19'20"E) in southern Mozambique.
source_text: Blood fed An. funestus adult females resting indoor were collected in houses between 06 and 12AM in Tihuquine (Chokwe District)... The collection was carried out over two week period in February 2009... Around 1500 were morphologically identified as belonging to the An. funestus group... A PCR was carried out using the protocol of [10] to confirm that collected females are An. funestus s.s.
